verdict.rationale: PayPal documents public REST APIs with OAuth client-credentials auth, published OpenAPI specifications for code generation, and programmatic APIs covering invoicing, disputes, payouts and subscriptions. A sandbox environment, an llms.txt file and markdown docs make these APIs accessible to agents. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The access token authenticates your app when calling PayPal REST APIs.
Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools.
The Invoicing REST API helps you create, update, send, and manage invoices programmatically from your backend systems.
Disputes API: A programmatic interface that enables you to automate dispute management actions directly from your systems.
